title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-11
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96] > (see notes)
source: 1 x Sony Microphone => Sony Portable Cassette Recorder [Monophonic] >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent mono audience tape with warm, crystal‑clear sound capturing a standout Dark Star from early ’69 Dead.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) capture using a single stage mic that delivers remarkably warm and clear audio for a 1969 source—many reviewers call it the best‑sounding ’69 AUD they’ve heard.  Musically the set is short but sweet, highlighted by a powerful Dark Star and a rare classical interlude, making the incomplete show still highly enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently five‑star reviews praise both the audio fidelity (excellent mono audience source) and the performance (notable Dark Star), with only one neutral comment about stereo processing, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono recording from a single stage DFC mic; warm and clear sound despite mono format. Some users note a synthesized stereo version exists, but the original tape is praised for its fidelity and ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short early‑69 set that feels sweet and vintage; incomplete but flows well, highlighted by an amazing Dark Star and occasional classical pieces.
